name: The Bidvest Group Limited
summary: The Bidvest Group Limited, an investment holding company, operates in the services, trading, and distribution industries in South Africa and internationally. It manufactures, markets, distributes, and supplies a range of healthcare products to private and public sectors; retails motors online; develops systems; operates in the vehicle auctioneering, testing, inspection, and certification sectors; and manufactures and trades power tools, strapping, forklifts, ovens, embroidery and sewing machines, tapes under the Hitachi, Signode, Unicarriers, Rational, Tajima, Juki, and Tesa brands.
